# Magic Hour

> > Magic Hour is an AI-powered video creation platform that enables users to generate and edit video content using artificial intelligence technology.

Magic Hour provides tools for creating AI-generated videos through an accessible web platform. Users can sign in to access the video creation suite and leverage advanced AI capabilities for content production.

## Key Topics

- Magic Hour
- AI video creation
- AI-powered video generation
- Video editing tools
- Authentication
- User accounts
- Content creation platform
- Artificial intelligence
- Video production
- Creative tools

## User Account & Authentication

- [Sign In](https://magichour.ai/sign-in): Authentication page for accessing Magic Hour AI video creation platform
